dimensions.note: The sole method logs structured entry and completion events without input payloads.
Strict validation and hashing complete before the single persistence write; failures propagate.
Tests cover deterministic scoring, thresholds, unavailable values, malformed and stale evidence, strict input, persistence, replay, and tampering.
A deterministic SHA-256 binds the normalized evaluation to its resource name; exact replay is stable and changed payloads cannot overwrite prior evaluations.
No network, file, process, or temporary-resource handles.
Published documentation and tests use only generic synthetic identifiers.
Arguments and every nested contract object are strict; arrays and text are bounded; scores, evidence references, chronology, hashes, and output are validated.
The immutable evaluation resource declares infinite lifetime and bounded GC retention.
This is a recommendation-only evaluator with no external CRUD lifecycle.
No external mutation exists; evaluation authority explicitly forbids operational effects.
The sole write uses a validated record ID plus deterministic evaluation hash, preventing incompatible collisions.
The model does not read stored state.
Registry reports no previously published version.
